jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The organization is seeking a hands-on, multi-disciplinary Chief Technology Officer to lead its end-to-end technology organization, spanning product engineering, IT infrastructure, and corporate and platform cybersecurity.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and partnering with executive leadership, this executive provides comprehensive oversight across technology, enterprise systems, and risk management. The Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer reports directly to this role.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Drive overall technology strategy, cloud infrastructure, and technical execution for the organization's core SaaS platform.
Manage the enterprise technology budget and drive cost optimization across software licensing, infrastructure procurement, hardware lifecycles, and vendor contracts.
Partner with executive leadership to transition new products from beta to market launch while actively managing technical debt.
Advise the CEO and Board of Directors on enterprise technical risk, disaster recovery, business continuity planning, and corporate cyber resilience.
Oversee day-to-day corporate IT operations, including endpoint management, automated provisioning and deprovisioning, and multi-tier helpdesk support.
Administer enterprise productivity suites and communication architectures while enforcing zero-trust access controls, single sign-on (SSO), and document retention policies.
Oversee business system infrastructure in close alignment with organizational leadership to ensure high uptime and integration security.
Direct organization-wide information security initiatives across corporate endpoints, networks, and SaaS tools.
Establish and audit enterprise IT policies, including acceptable use, zero-trust identity and access management (IAM), data loss prevention (DLP), and offboarding protocols.
Enforce compliance and audit readiness—including SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, ISO 27001, and c3/c4 non-profit legal boundaries—in collaboration with Legal, HR, and Finance.
Evaluate alpha projects and proofs of concept across departments, guiding execution to integrate them into the core SaaS platform or architect them as standalone, scalable services.
Mitigate vendor lock-in risk by establishing standardized data portability and integration frameworks across corporate SaaS applications.
Serve as direct manager to the Chief Product, Engineering, and Data Officer (CPEDO), establishing shared goals and aligning product, engineering, and data strategies with enterprise infrastructure and security standards.
Partner with the CPEDO on budget, resourcing, and prioritization trade-offs across product, engineering, and data initiatives.
Build, mentor, and scale a service-oriented IT and security team aligned with organizational growth objectives.
Establish pragmatic automated internal processes that maintain rigorous security standards without introducing operational friction for staff.

Qualifications

12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including roles such as Director of IT, Head of IT/Operations Technology, VP of IT, or Chief Technology Officer.
Demonstrated experience managing enterprise IT and information security stacks, zero-trust architectures, IAM, and automated endpoint management.
Experience driving capital and operational expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) strategies for corporate IT, including SaaS license management, hardware procurement cycles, and third-party vendor governance.
Proven track record leading enterprise security operations and successfully navigating SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audit cycles.
Expertise in architecting, securing, and administering enterprise collaboration platforms and workplace productivity suites.
Proven track record of building and leading technical teams across a broad range of expertise.
Experience building or scaling an internal IT function through periods of organizational growth.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, executive leadership, and Board members.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual salary: $220,000 to $230,000,
commensurate with experience.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Healthcare Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options.
403(b) retirement plan with an employer match.
Paid vacation, paid holidays, and paid sick leave.
Paid parental leave.
Professional development and education reimbursement assistance.
Monthly technology and wellness stipend.

Essential duties reflect the primary functions assigned to this role and may be adjusted or reassigned at any time.
Employees must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions, absent undue hardship.
The organization maintains a zero-tolerance policy regarding abuse and inappropriate behavior.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
As a Manager in the Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US) Office of the CIO (OCIO) PMO team you will play a key role in support of the PMO and the use of project management practices and methodologies across DT-US to enable world-class delivery of our firm's internal technology programs.

The DT-US PMO team is part of the Office of the CIO (OCIO) and reports to the US OCIO Leader. The OCIO leads the development and implementation for technology strategy at Deloitte and drives the strategic initiatives to build market leading technology capabilities. DT-US powers IT for Deloitte's 175K+ professionals while supporting business priorities and transformational initiatives in areas such as AI, Cloud, and Cyber.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 31st 2026.

Work you'll do

As the DT-US PMO Operations Manager, you will lead the PMO Operations team and own the processes, tools, and reporting that give DT-US service area leaders and PMO leadership timely insight into portfolio status, risks, and issues. You will serve as the process owner and administrator for the ServiceNow SPM module, design AI and automation solutions that create efficiency and repeatability across program management, and maintain the reusable templates, tools, and governance frameworks PMO makes available to teams across DT-US where PMO is not directly deployed. You will also be available to step into short-term, critical needs across DT-US to help teams stand up program and project management processes and tooling.

As the DT-US PMO Operations Manager, you will build and demonstrate strong competency and business knowledge across PMO Operations. As the sole leader of the Operations team, you are accountable for team direction, coaching, performance feedback, and overall PMO service quality. This includes managing the team's budget and resource assignments, leading performance management, and overseeing training and certification requirements.

Responsibilities include:

Team Leadership: Lead and manage the PMO Operations team as its sole leader, providing direction, coaching, and performance feedback, and owning overall team service quality.
Budget & Resource Management: Analyze the PMO Operations budget and manage resource assignments across the team to ensure appropriate coverage across programs.
Performance Management: Own the performance management cycle for the PMO team.
Learning & Development: Identify learning & development opportunities and manage certification requirements (e.g., PMP) for the PMO team.
Team Communications & Events: Own recurring PMO team communications, including monthly all-hands meetings and any in-person team events.
Portfolio Reporting & Insight: Own portfolio-level reporting, working with program managers to deliver timely, accurate insight into program status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to DT-US service area leaders and PMO leadership.
Governance Support: Maintain PMO governance standards and processes that support consistent program and project delivery across DT-US.
ServiceNow SPM Process Ownership: Serve as the process owner and administrator for the ServiceNow SPM module, with elevated access to configure, maintain, and evolve PMO's use of the platform.
AI & Automation: Design AI and automation solutions that create efficiency and repeatability in program management, including reporting, planning, and knowledge management.
Reusable PM Assets: Develop and maintain the templates, tools, and governance frameworks PMO makes available to teams across DT-US where PMO is not directly deployed.
Short-Term Critical Support: Step into short-term, critical needs across DT-US to help teams stand up program and project management processes and tooling.
Process Improvement: Evaluate current PMO processes and recommend improvements to increase team efficiency and effectiveness.
Stakeholder Interaction: Interact with senior leaders, prepare presentations on PMO strategy and performance, and manage stakeholder relationships.
Quality Management: Evaluate and maintain quality management standards within the PMO.
Travel Requirements: Ability to travel 0-10%, predominantly remote with the option of working from home or a nearby Deloitte office.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Required Qualifications:

6+ years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management working on large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives utilizing a structured project management methodology and formal tools/approaches (PMBOK, Prince2, etc)
3+ years of experience managing full lifecycle IT projects including overseeing the strategy / business case development, developing the implementation plan to support the business case, and driving the implementation of the plan to deliver the final program objectives
Recent experience using generative AI tools (e.g., prompt design, workflow automation) to improve program reporting, documentation, or process efficiency

1+ year of people/process management experience including but not limited to overseeing and mentoring numerous other PMs, Project Coordinators, etc.
3+ years of project / program financial management (e.g., Planning, Forecasting, Budgeting, Business Case Development, etc.) in addition to experience in the planning, estimation, resource management, project tracking, scope control, risk and issues management as well as stakeholder relationship management.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration or equivalent educational and/or equivalent relevant professional experience
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve; this role is predominantly remote with the option to work from home or a nearby Deloitte office
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications:

PMP Certification
1+ year of SPM module administration experience
Experience working with MS Planner Plan 3 is highly preferred
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a matrixed professional services firm OR consulting
Strategic and critical thinker with the ability to make connections across programs and logically structure issues and determine recommended resolutions
Excellent written and verbal communications skills and strong executive presence.
Strong MS PowerPoint skills with proven record of creating high impact, audience-specific presentations.
Self-starter comfortable taking the lead and managing multiple initiatives with an ability to effectively collaborate across teams
Detail-oriented with ability to plan, prioritize, and make decisions on multiple projects

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,500-$171,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.

Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.

Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.
Familiarity with privacy requirements and secure handling of sensitive consumer data.
Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.
Consistent helpdesk performance, reliable onboarding and offboarding, and robust endpoint security and asset tracking.
Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

Annual base salary: $170,000 - $180,000

Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance
Retirement benefits with employer match

As a Manager in the Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US) Office of the CIO (OCIO) PMO team you will play a key role in support of the PMO and the use of project management practices and methodologies across DT-US to enable world-class delivery of our firm's internal technology programs.

The DT-US PMO team is part of the Office of the CIO (OCIO) and reports to the US OCIO Leader. The OCIO leads the development and implementation for technology strategy at Deloitte and drives the strategic initiatives to build market leading technology capabilities. DT-US powers IT for Deloitte's 175K+ professionals while supporting business priorities and transformational initiatives in areas such as AI, Cloud, and Cyber.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 31st 2026.

Work you'll do

As the DT-US PMO Operations Manager, you will lead the PMO Operations team and own the processes, tools, and reporting that give DT-US service area leaders and PMO leadership timely insight into portfolio status, risks, and issues. You will serve as the process owner and administrator for the ServiceNow SPM module, design AI and automation solutions that create efficiency and repeatability across program management, and maintain the reusable templates, tools, and governance frameworks PMO makes available to teams across DT-US where PMO is not directly deployed. You will also be available to step into short-term, critical needs across DT-US to help teams stand up program and project management processes and tooling.

As the DT-US PMO Operations Manager, you will build and demonstrate strong competency and business knowledge across PMO Operations. As the sole leader of the Operations team, you are accountable for team direction, coaching, performance feedback, and overall PMO service quality. This includes managing the team's budget and resource assignments, leading performance management, and overseeing training and certification requirements.

Responsibilities include:

Team Leadership: Lead and manage the PMO Operations team as its sole leader, providing direction, coaching, and performance feedback, and owning overall team service quality.
Budget & Resource Management: Analyze the PMO Operations budget and manage resource assignments across the team to ensure appropriate coverage across programs.
Performance Management: Own the performance management cycle for the PMO team.
Learning & Development: Identify learning & development opportunities and manage certification requirements (e.g., PMP) for the PMO team.
Team Communications & Events: Own recurring PMO team communications, including monthly all-hands meetings and any in-person team events.
Portfolio Reporting & Insight: Own portfolio-level reporting, working with program managers to deliver timely, accurate insight into program status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to DT-US service area leaders and PMO leadership.
Governance Support: Maintain PMO governance standards and processes that support consistent program and project delivery across DT-US.
ServiceNow SPM Process Ownership: Serve as the process owner and administrator for the ServiceNow SPM module, with elevated access to configure, maintain, and evolve PMO's use of the platform.
AI & Automation: Design AI and automation solutions that create efficiency and repeatability in program management, including reporting, planning, and knowledge management.
Reusable PM Assets: Develop and maintain the templates, tools, and governance frameworks PMO makes available to teams across DT-US where PMO is not directly deployed.
Short-Term Critical Support: Step into short-term, critical needs across DT-US to help teams stand up program and project management processes and tooling.
Process Improvement: Evaluate current PMO processes and recommend improvements to increase team efficiency and effectiveness.
Stakeholder Interaction: Interact with senior leaders, prepare presentations on PMO strategy and performance, and manage stakeholder relationships.
Quality Management: Evaluate and maintain quality management standards within the PMO.
Travel Requirements: Ability to travel 0-10%, predominantly remote with the option of working from home or a nearby Deloitte office.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Required Qualifications:

6+ years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management working on large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives utilizing a structured project management methodology and formal tools/approaches (PMBOK, Prince2, etc)
3+ years of experience managing full lifecycle IT projects including overseeing the strategy / business case development, developing the implementation plan to support the business case, and driving the implementation of the plan to deliver the final program objectives
Recent experience using generative AI tools (e.g., prompt design, workflow automation) to improve program reporting, documentation, or process efficiency

1+ year of people/process management experience including but not limited to overseeing and mentoring numerous other PMs, Project Coordinators, etc.
3+ years of project / program financial management (e.g., Planning, Forecasting, Budgeting, Business Case Development, etc.) in addition to experience in the planning, estimation, resource management, project tracking, scope control, risk and issues management as well as stakeholder relationship management.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration or equivalent educational and/or equivalent relevant professional experience
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve; this role is predominantly remote with the option to work from home or a nearby Deloitte office
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications:

PMP Certification
1+ year of SPM module administration experience
Experience working with MS Planner Plan 3 is highly preferred
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a matrixed professional services firm OR consulting
Strategic and critical thinker with the ability to make connections across programs and logically structure issues and determine recommended resolutions
Excellent written and verbal communications skills and strong executive presence.
Strong MS PowerPoint skills with proven record of creating high impact, audience-specific presentations.
Self-starter comfortable taking the lead and managing multiple initiatives with an ability to effectively collaborate across teams
Detail-oriented with ability to plan, prioritize, and make decisions on multiple projects

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.

Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.

Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.

Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

Retirement benefits with employer match
